spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (प्रथते)
To be famous or renowned.
r. 10th cl. (प्राथयति)
1 To throw or cast.
2 To scatter, to spread.
3 To celebrate.

f. (-था)
Fame, celebrity.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

n. (-नं)
1 Spreading, extension, scattering.
2 Throwing, projecting.
3 Celebrating.
E.
प्रथ to cast, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 First, prior, initial.
2 Chief, principal.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, अमच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-सः)
The first or lowest degree of fine or punishment.
E.
प्रथम, and साहस infliction.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Displaying, making manifest, famous, &c.
2 Seeing, beholding.
3 Casting, throwing.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Famous, celebrated.
2 Made known, declared.
3 Spread, scattered.
4

Cast, thrown.
6 Intent upon, engaged in, occupied by, devoted to.
E.
प्रथा fame, aff. इतच्.

f. (-तिः)
Celebrity, notoriety.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, ति Uṇādi aff., and इट् aug.

m. (-मा)
Greatness, magnitude.
E.
पृथु large, इमनिच् aff. form irr.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Large, great, having size or magnitude.
E.
प्रथिमा magnitude, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very large.
E.
पृथु large, इष्ठन् superl. aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very large.
E.
पृथु large, and ईयसुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
The young of any animal.
E.
प्रथ to be famous, कुकन् aff.: see पृथुक.

m. (-कः)
A student, one who has just commenced the perusal of the Vedas.
E.
प्रथम first, कल्प beginning, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
First, of the first, initial, initiative.
E.
प्रथम, and ठञ् aff.

n. (-म्यं)
Firstness, priority.
E.
प्रथम, and ष्यञ् aff.
